rows.note: Use 犯 for committing a crime, sin, offence, or mistake; it is the all-purpose choice for this sense.

example.english: I don’t want to commit a mistake.

rows.note: Use 承諾 when someone pledges or binds themselves to do something.

example.english: I commit to completing the work according to the plan.
example.traditional: 我承諾會照計劃完成工作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 nok6 wui5 ziu3 gai3 waak6 jyun4 sing4 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use 收監 when authorities place someone in prison, especially in legal or official contexts.

example.english: The court will formally commit the prisoner to prison today.
example.traditional: 法院今日正式將犯人收監。
example.jyutping: faat3 jyun2 gam1 jat6 zing3 sik1 zoeng1 faan6 jan4 sau1 gaam1

rows.note: Use 強制送院 when someone is involuntarily sent to a hospital for assessment or treatment, especially for mental-health reasons.

example.english: The police had to commit him to a hospital for assessment.
example.traditional: 警方將佢強制送院接受評估。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zoeng1 keoi5 koeng4 zai3 sung3 jyun2 zip3 sau6 ping4 gu2
